# How the newest and youngest billionaires on Forbes’ 2024 ranking found their success
  * [ Report this article ](https://www.linkedin.com/uas/login?session_redirect=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.linkedin.com%2Fpulse%2Fhow-newest-youngest-billionaires-forbes-2024-ranking-found-d4m1e&trk=article-ssr-frontend-pulse_ellipsis-menu-semaphore-sign-in-redirect&guestReportContentType=PONCHO_ARTICLE&_f=guest-reporting)


[ Forbes  ](https://www.linkedin.com/company/forbes-magazine)
###  Forbes 
####  Official page of Forbes, the world’s leading voice for entrepreneurial success and free enterprise. 
Published Apr 5, 2024 
[ + Follow ](https://www.linkedin.com/signup/cold-join?session_redirect=%2Fpulse%2Fhow-newest-youngest-billionaires-forbes-2024-ranking-found-d4m1e%2F&trk=article-ssr-frontend-pulse_publisher-author-card)
This week has been a fun one at Forbes, as our editorial team knocked it out of the park with a treasure trove of stories centered around the [2024 World’s Billionaires List](https://www.linkedin.com/redir/redirect?url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww%2Eforbes%2Ecom%2Fbillionaires%2F%3Futm_source%3Dlinkedin_newsletter%26utm_medium%3Dsocial%26utm_campaign%3Dforbes_edge&urlhash=b1Es&trk=article-ssr-frontend-pulse_little-text-block). From revealing who earned their billions in [tech](https://www.linkedin.com/redir/redirect?url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww%2Eforbes%2Ecom%2Fsites%2Fphoebeliu%2F2024%2F04%2F02%2Ftech-billionaires-have-added-an-astonishing-750-billion-to-their-fortunes-over-the-past-year%2F%3Futm_source%3Dlinkedin_newsletter%26utm_medium%3Dsocial%26utm_campaign%3Dforbes_edge&urlhash=J9J_&trk=article-ssr-frontend-pulse_little-text-block) and [artificial intelligence](https://www.linkedin.com/redir/redirect?url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww%2Eforbes%2Ecom%2Fsites%2Fphoebeliu%2F2024%2F04%2F02%2Fthe-billionaires-getting-rich-from-ai-2024%2F%3Futm_source%3Dlinkedin_newsletter%26utm_medium%3Dsocial%26utm_campaign%3Dforbes_edge&urlhash=9WHT&trk=article-ssr-frontend-pulse_little-text-block), to highlighting the world’s most [financially successful women](https://www.linkedin.com/redir/redirect?url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww%2Eforbes%2Ecom%2Fsites%2Fnataliewu%2F2024%2F04%2F03%2Fthe-worlds-richest-self-made-women-in-2024-taylor-swift-kim-kardashian-rihanna%2F%3Futm_source%3Dlinkedin_newsletter%26utm_medium%3Dsocial%26utm_campaign%3Dforbes_edge&urlhash=ZrnN&trk=article-ssr-frontend-pulse_little-text-block), to a breakdown of [riches by country](https://www.linkedin.com/redir/redirect?url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww%2Eforbes%2Ecom%2Fsites%2Fannikagrosser%2F2024%2F04%2F03%2Fthe-richest-billionaire-in-each-country-2024%2F%3Futm_source%3Dlinkedin_newsletter%26utm_medium%3Dsocial%26utm_campaign%3Dforbes_edge&urlhash=sSli&trk=article-ssr-frontend-pulse_little-text-block), our reporters have provided a variety of ways to dive into the stories behind the world’s 2,781 billionaires.
And while you don’t have to be a billionaire to be successful, there are lessons to be learned from how these individuals became members of the three-comma club.
In his story about the [newest billionaires to join the list](https://www.linkedin.com/redir/redirect?url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww%2Eforbes%2Ecom%2Fsites%2Fsegunolakoyenikan%2F2024%2F04%2F02%2Fnew-billionaires-2024-taylor-swift-magic-johnson-and-263-others-join-the-ranks-this-year%2F%3Futm_source%3Dlinkedin_newsletter%26utm_medium%3Dsocial%26utm_campaign%3Dforbes_edge&urlhash=_AA0&trk=article-ssr-frontend-pulse_little-text-block), Forbes staff writer [Segun Olakoyenikan](https://www.linkedin.com/redir/redirect?url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww%2Eforbes%2Ecom%2Fsites%2Fsegunolakoyenikan%2F%3Futm_source%3Dlinkedin_newsletter%26utm_medium%3Dsocial%26utm_campaign%3Dforbes_edge&urlhash=DdeU&trk=article-ssr-frontend-pulse_little-text-block) writes that there are 265 newcomers this year, up from 150 in 2023. And once again, the U.S. leads the way in fresh-faced billionaires, with 67 Americans joining the club. The wealthiest among them is Todd Graves, the founder of fast-food chain Raising Cane’s, whose net worth stands at an estimated $9.1 billion.
Meanwhile, China has 31 new faces on the list, with the richest being Maggie Gu, Molly Miao and Ren Xiaoqing, the cofounders of Gen Z fashion giant Shein, each worth an estimated $4.2 billion each.
The most famous newcomer is—you guessed it—Taylor Swift, whose Eras Tour is the first to surpass $1 billion in revenue. The 34-year-old has amassed a $1.1 billion fortune, and is the first musician to hit ten-figure status solely based on her songs and performances.
While many of the new billionaires inherited their wealth, more than half are self-made. The youngest of them is Japan’s Shunsaku Sagami, the founder of Tokyo-based advisory firm M&A Research Institute, which utilizes AI to find buyers for companies. The 33-year-old is worth an estimated $1.9 billion.
Make sure to [give the full story a read](https://www.linkedin.com/redir/redirect?url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww%2Eforbes%2Ecom%2Fsites%2Fsegunolakoyenikan%2F2024%2F04%2F02%2Fnew-billionaires-2024-taylor-swift-magic-johnson-and-263-others-join-the-ranks-this-year%2F%3Futm_source%3Dlinkedin_newsletter%26utm_medium%3Dsocial%26utm_campaign%3Dforbes_edge&urlhash=_AA0&trk=article-ssr-frontend-pulse_little-text-block) for information on which industries minted the most new billionaires this year, and don’t skip the other great articles about this year’s Billionaires List.

##  Financial planning: How much do you need to earn to afford a home in 2024?
[ Credit: Getty Images ](https://www.linkedin.com/redir/redirect?url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww%2Eforbes%2Ecom%2Fsites%2Fterriwilliams%2F2024%2F03%2F27%2Fbuyers-need-a-six-figure-salary-to-comfortably-afford-a-home-zillow-finds%2F%3Futm_source%3Dlinkedin_newsletter%26utm_medium%3Dsocial%26utm_campaign%3Dforbes_edge&urlhash=QUkc&trk=article-ssr-frontend-pulse_publishing-image-block)
Homeownership is getting more expensive. The dream of buying a home likely feels unrealistic for many workers across the country, as a recent report from Zillow found that the [average income to afford a home](https://www.linkedin.com/redir/redirect?url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww%2Eforbes%2Ecom%2Fsites%2Fterriwilliams%2F2024%2F03%2F27%2Fbuyers-need-a-six-figure-salary-to-comfortably-afford-a-home-zillow-finds%2F%3Futm_source%3Dlinkedin_newsletter%26utm_medium%3Dsocial%26utm_campaign%3Dforbes_edge&urlhash=QUkc&trk=article-ssr-frontend-pulse_little-text-block) has risen to $106,000.
## Recommended by LinkedIn
[ Soon, we could all be billionaires… Kat Birchley  10 years ago  ](https://www.linkedin.com/pulse/soon-we-could-all-billionaires-kathleen-birchley)
[ The It Girl Economy Jaiya Gill  1 year ago  ](https://www.linkedin.com/pulse/girl-economy-jaiya-gill-htdme)
[ The 2024 Billionaire Report: Insights Into the World’s… HeliFlite  1 year ago  ](https://www.linkedin.com/pulse/2024-billionaire-report-insights-worlds-wealthiest-whats-next-beaxe)
That’s an 80% increase from $59,000 in 2020, according to Anushna Prakash, Zillow’s economic research data scientist who conducted the study.
“The monthly mortgage payment on a typical U.S. home has nearly doubled since January 2020, up 96.4% to $2,188 (assuming a 10% down payment),” Prakash says.
But there are places where the income needed to buy a home is lower, and Zillow lists both the most affordable and unaffordable cities in the U.S. Give the full story from [contributor Terri Williams](https://www.linkedin.com/redir/redirect?url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww%2Eforbes%2Ecom%2Fsites%2Fterriwilliams%2F%3Futm_source%3Dlinkedin_newsletter%26utm_medium%3Dsocial%26utm_campaign%3Dforbes_edge&urlhash=k-kP&trk=article-ssr-frontend-pulse_little-text-block) a read to find out where you might want to consider moving.
Read the full story: [Buyers need a six-figure salary to comfortably afford a home, Zillow finds](https://www.linkedin.com/redir/redirect?url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww%2Eforbes%2Ecom%2Fsites%2Fterriwilliams%2F2024%2F03%2F27%2Fbuyers-need-a-six-figure-salary-to-comfortably-afford-a-home-zillow-finds%2F%3Futm_source%3Dlinkedin_newsletter%26utm_medium%3Dsocial%26utm_campaign%3Dforbes_edge&urlhash=QUkc&trk=article-ssr-frontend-pulse_little-text-block)
